info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Deposit Lending By Param1-spec
info.description: The Deposit Lending Retrieval API allows users to obtain information about standing orders related to deposit lending. By specifying a parameter, consumers can easily access details regarding specific lending arrangements. This API is typically utilized by financial institutions and developers looking to integrate lending functionalities into their applications. Use cases include checking the status of loans, managing standing orders, or retrieving lending details for customer inquiries.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the details of a specific standing order in the deposit lending system using its unique identifier. Ensure you provide the correct standing order ID to obtain the relevant data.

requestBody.description: This request body contains the parameters needed to retrieve the standing order details for the specified transaction. Ensure that all required fields are properly set before sending the request.

200.description: Request completed successfully and the standing order details are returned.

GetDepositLendingByParam1Request.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation on standing orders related to deposit lending.

customerId.description: The unique identifier for the customer.

accountId.description: The unique identifier for the customer's account.

productCode.description: The code representing the financial product.

termMonths.description: The duration of the loan or standing order in months.
